course_name: 計算機與人工智慧概論
outline:
介紹Matlab界面、程式語法、方程式繪圖、線性回歸。第二部份為人工智慧概論，主要為chat gpt, Google Gemini的使用。

This course will focus on basic MATLAB, programing, plotting, and linear regresssion.  The second part is basic AI concept and how to use Chatgpt.
schedule:
week 1~2: Introduction, Array Operations
week 3~4: Structured Programming and Functions, Plotting
week 5~6: Graphical User Interface
week 7~8: Midterm exam
week 9~10: Integration and Differentiation
week 11~13: Root Finding, Linear Equations
week 14~15: Statistics, Analysis, Curve Fitting
week 16~18: Chatgpt, do final report
assessment:
Attendence (10%)
Midterm homwork project (45%)
Final homework project  (45%)
